mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g_exam (EXAM_ID, USER_ID, EXAM_CODE, EXAM_NAME, SUBJECT_TYPE, EXAM_LV, EXAM_TIME, GRA) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{examCode}, #{examName}, #{subjectType}, #{examLv}, #{examTime}, #{gra})
mapper.select: SELECT e.EXAM_ID, e.USER_ID, e.EXAM_CODE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, e.EXAM_LV, e.EXAM_TIME, e.GRA, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, el.CODE_DESC as EXAM_LV_DESC FROM g_exam e LEFT JOIN g_user u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code el ON e.EXAM_LV = el.CODE_ID WHERE e.EXAM_ID = #{examId}

SELECT e.EXAM_ID, e.USER_ID, e.EXAM_CODE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, e.EXAM_LV, e.EXAM_TIME, e.GRA, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, el.CODE_DESC as EXAM_LV_DESC FROM g_exam e LEFT JOIN g_user u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code el ON e.EXAM_LV = el.CODE_ID ORDER BY e.EXAM_ID

SELECT e.EXAM_ID, e.USER_ID, e.EXAM_CODE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, e.EXAM_LV, e.EXAM_TIME, e.GRA, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, el.CODE_DESC as EXAM_LV_DESC FROM g_exam e LEFT JOIN g_user u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code el ON e.EXAM_LV = el.CODE_ID WHERE e.GRA = #{gra} ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC

SELECT e.EXAM_ID, e.USER_ID, e.EXAM_CODE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, e.EXAM_LV, e.EXAM_TIME, e.GRA, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, el.CODE_DESC as EXAM_LV_DESC FROM g_exam e LEFT JOIN g_user u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code el ON e.EXAM_LV = el.CODE_ID WHERE e.EXAM_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{examName}, '%') AND e.SUBJECT_TYPE = #{subjectType} ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC
